note: Loess-hills conservation area east of I-29 near Watson, with two primitive camping areas on MDC's map, each with a privy: a gravel lot and grassy lane loop below the Charity Lake dam at the Route RA entrance, and a gravel loop with back-in spurs off 185 St on the area's southeast side, about 3 km away by road. Spot length is not published. --Claude
summary: Confirmed: MDC 'Individual Campsites' (brochure: 'Primitive camping is permitted only in areas identified on area map'), free, FCFS, no hookups, 14-day limit; privy added. Two mapped camping areas 3 km apart on different roads - split proposed for the 185 St loop. Pin = GIS camping point below the dam, fine. Not waterfront kept (camp is below the dam). Phone matches.
flags: SPLIT (proposed): MDC's 10/7/2019 map and GIS show TWO Primitive Camping Areas. (1) the stored one: GIS camping point 249 (40.47438,-95.58333, the stored pin) on a grassy lane loop just south of gravel lot 1049, below the Charity Lake dam, entered from Route RA at I-29 Exit 116. (2) GIS camping point 620 (40.45896,-95.55414), on a separate gravel loop road off 185 St (gravel, reached from G Ave) on the area's southeast side, with a privy and lot 1051 at its entrance - ~3.0 km straight-line from (1), no internal road between them (the map's interior links are service roads/foot access). Imagery shows (2) as a developed ~200 x 170 m gravel loop around a mown field with ~6 gravel back-in spurs (~15-20 m) on its east side - arguably the better camping spot for a 23-ft rig. Suggested split entry: 'Brickyard Hill Conservation Area - 185 St Camping Area' at ~40.4600,-95.5540 (the east-side spurs), same MDC page/phone, not waterfront (no water body at the loop).

INCLUSION/FIT: area page lists 'Camping: Individual Campsites'; no area-specific camping restriction in the regulations (standard 3CSR 10-11 140 text). Stored camp: lot 1049 is a ~25 x 80 m gravel lot (GIS 'Paved', imagery gravel) reached by gravel from Route RA; the camping point sits on grass beside a gravel lane loop south of it - a 23-ft rig fits the lot and lane. No ford or 4WD wording.

WATERFRONT (stored not waterfront, kept): the camp is below the Charity Lake (13 acres) dam - the lot runs up to the dam/ramp lane, but camping point 249 is ~150 m south of the water with the dam between. Below-the-dam rule: no lake value.
PIN: stored 40.47438,-95.58333 = GIS camping point 249 - fine.
PHONE: (816) 271-3100 on the area page matches.
Note rewritten: generic MDC text, acreage, the camping-spot count, the 14-day line and the directions dropped; the two camping areas described.
